unit.why: A sick man comes to Rabbi Zvi, who heals him through a Torah teaching at the Sabbath table, followed by the author's homiletic elaboration.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מפי מגידי אמת שפ"א בא
stories.end_quote: בסוד התרומה בסוד תרי ממאה והבן
stories.summary_en: A gravely ill man comes to Rabbi Zvi before Shabbat Terumah. Rabbi Zvi says the cure will come only through his Torah teaching. At the Sabbath table he gives a gematria derashah: Terumah plus the Name equals 'refuah shelemah'. He has the sick man give 26 coins to charity, and the author adds a kabbalistic explanation.
